# Cartography

<!-- Generated by `node scripts/cartography/cli.ts --write`. Do not edit: change a package.json `description` or a directory header instead. -->

The workspace packages, the compiler stages and one line per source directory, then one line per directory of `scripts`, `jvm`, `php` and `.github/actions`. A line comes from the first sentence of the leading comment of the directory's `index.ts`, else the first line of its `README.md`, else, for a package's `src`, the package description.

## Packages

| Package | Directory | Role | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@seampact/cli` | `packages/core/cli` | core | The seampact command: init, compile, check, lint, diff, generate, bundle, explain. |
| `@seampact/codegen-core` | `packages/core/codegen-core` | core | The API the code generators are written against. |

| `@seampact/pack-laravel` | `packages/packs/pack-laravel` | pack | Laravel API Resources and paginators: data wrapping, length-aware and cursor pages. |

| `@seampact/signed-webhooks` | `packages/runtime/signed-webhooks` | helper | Verifies a template-signed webhook (HMAC, timestamp tolerance, secret rotation) inside an authenticate hook. |

| `@seampact/codegen-angular` | `packages/targets/codegen-angular` | target | Generates an injectable Angular api service over HttpClient with signal readers built on resource(), over the typed fetch client, with no query library, and opt-in NgRx action groups and effects. |
| `@seampact/codegen-axios` | `packages/targets/codegen-axios` | target | Generates the typed client of the fetch target over your own axios instance, so the React, Vue and Angular targets run over axios. |
| `@seampact/codegen-class-validator` | `packages/targets/codegen-class-validator` | target | Generates decorated class-validator DTO classes per schema and direction, with Standard Schema adapters for the NestJS target. |
| `@seampact/codegen-express` | `packages/targets/codegen-express` | target | Generates an Express router per api that serves each contract route behind its access, validation and reply checks around your handler map, on Express 4 and 5, validating with zod. |
| `@seampact/codegen-fastify` | `packages/targets/codegen-fastify` | target | Generates a Fastify plugin per api that registers each contract route with its access, validation and reply checks around your handler map, on Fastify 5, validating with the zod or yup link you give or with Ajv validators it generates. |
| `@seampact/codegen-fetch` | `packages/targets/codegen-fetch` | target | Generates a typed fetch client with one method per operation, returning its success and error responses as typed results. |
| `@seampact/codegen-hono` | `packages/targets/codegen-hono` | target | Generates a registerRoutes function per api that adds each contract route to a Hono 4 app with its access, validation and reply checks around your handler map, validating with zod. |
| `@seampact/codegen-msw` | `packages/targets/codegen-msw` | target | Generates Mock Service Worker 2 handlers per operation that answer the contract's examples, or the typed success or error a test gives, in the api's wire format. |
| `@seampact/codegen-nestjs` | `packages/targets/codegen-nestjs` | target | Generates the NestJS boundary around your controllers: a decorator per operation, the access guard, an input decorator whose pipe validates, a handler wrapper or opt-in reply interceptor that writes the checked reply, the error filter and a boot check, validating with zod. |
| `@seampact/codegen-react` | `packages/targets/codegen-react` | target | Generates TanStack Query or SWR options and React hooks, an RTK Query api, or plain fetch hooks with no query library, over the typed fetch client, with keys, invalidation and paging read from the contract. |
| `@seampact/codegen-ts` | `packages/targets/codegen-ts` | target | Generates a named TypeScript type per schema and each operation's input, output and error union. |
| `@seampact/codegen-vue` | `packages/targets/codegen-vue` | target | Generates TanStack Query or Pinia Colada options and Vue composables, or plain fetch composables with no query library, over the typed fetch client, with keys, invalidation and paging read from the contract. |
| `@seampact/codegen-yup` | `packages/targets/codegen-yup` | target | Generates Standard Schema yup validators per schema and direction, and one input validator per operation. |
| `@seampact/codegen-zod` | `packages/targets/codegen-zod` | target | Generates Standard Schema zod validators per schema and direction, and one input validator per operation. |
| `@seampact/binary` | `packages/tools/binary` | tool | The standalone compiler binary: the CLI as a Node single executable application for five platforms, with the first-party packs embedded. |
| `@seampact/docs-site` | `packages/tools/docs-site` | tool | The documentation website: Starlight on GitHub Pages, built from the repository's docs/ folder. |
| `@seampact/http-suite` | `packages/tools/http-suite` | tool | The shared black-box HTTP suite: JSON case scripts, the sample app's control routes, a runner against a base URL and a report keyed by checklist id. |

## Python packages

The uv workspace `python/`. A source directory is a package with an `__init__.py`; its line is the first sentence of the module docstring, and a generated `__init__.py` gets none.

| Package | Directory | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `seampact-codegen` | `python/codegen` | The neutral code generation of the seampact Python targets and the framework-free runtime of generated code. |
| `seampact-compiler` | `python/compiler` | The seampact compiler binary for one platform, run by seampact-ir. |
| `seampact-django` | `python/django` | The Django layer the seampact DRF and Ninja targets share: the URLconf and settings emitters and the Django runtime of generated code. |
| `seampact-drf` | `python/drf` | The seampact Django REST Framework target: its generator and the runtime of the code it generates. |
| `seampact-fastapi` | `python/fastapi` | The FastAPI target of seampact: its generator and the placement runtime of the generated code. |
| `seampact-hooks` | `python/hooks` | The seampact hook protocols and the values they exchange, for Python apps and generated code. |
| `seampact-ir` | `python/ir` | The seampact IR model, naming and reader for Python generators. |
| `seampact-ninja` | `python/ninja` | The Django Ninja target of seampact: its generator and the placement runtime of the generated code. |
| `seampact-signed-webhooks` | `python/signed-webhooks` | Verifies a template-signed webhook (HMAC, timestamp tolerance, secret rotation) inside an authenticate hook. |

## Compiler stages

In pipeline order (ADR 0006 section 1).

| Stage | Directories |
|---|---|
| load | `packages/core/compiler/src/load` |
| validate | `packages/core/compiler/src/validate` |
| tree | `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/tree/nodes`, `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/tree/schemas` |
| access | `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/access/identity`, `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/access/rights` |
| derive | `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/derive/wire`, `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/derive/errors` |
| link | `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/link` |
| finalize | `packages/core/compiler/src/finalize` |

## Source directories

### `@seampact/cli`

- `packages/core/cli/src`: The seampact command line: `runCli`, its commands, and the app config reader they share.
- `packages/core/cli/src/commands`: The commands the CLI runs, `init`, `compile`, `generate`, `check`, `lint`, `diff`, `bundle` and `explain`, and the steps between the app config and the target packages: the sources compiled, the IR filtered per entry, the link checks and the link set.
- `packages/core/cli/src/config`: The app config and the monorepo root config as the CLI reads them: the YAML readers and their refusals, the root an app belongs to, the OpenAPI documents an app and a root write, the target packages an app names, resolved from the app's own project, the artefacts each entry generates and the compatibility matrix check.
- `packages/core/cli/src/editor-schemas`: The workspace's editor schemas that `compile --editor-schemas` writes: the authoring schemas with each name position listing the declared names (grammar section 3).

### `@seampact/codegen-core`

- `packages/core/codegen-core/src`: The API the code generators are written against: target definitions, link descriptors, refusals, and the steps around a target's generate (IR support and link checks, header, formatting, file writer), and the helpers targets share (IR locations, located refusals, planned names, property keys, the front query plan).
- `packages/core/codegen-core/src/fetch-client`: The fetch client's reading of the contract (ADR 0021): the per-operation request and success plan, the page and payload readers, the wire format forms it refuses, and the type namespace names.
- `packages/core/codegen-core/src/front-queries`: The framework-neutral query plan the front targets render (ADR 0021): per operation its form, export names, key, resource, call options and next-page rule, the front runtime each front target copies into its output, and the query module sources the TypeScript front targets share (plain fetch and TanStack Query factories, and the parts of the plain fetch hooks and composables).
- `packages/core/codegen-core/src/node-server`: The shared server boundary every Node and Web-standard server target generates (ADR 0016, ADR 0020) over the runtime it imports from `@seampact/server-runtime`: the generate-time check of the installed runtime (ADR 0025), the emitters of the route table, handler interfaces and hook types, the target options parser, the path segments a router cannot read, and the assembly of one api's boundary files around a target's placement.
- `packages/core/codegen-core/src/validators`: The validator-neutral half of every validators target: the module layout and export names, the descriptor, the `rules` option, the shared wire checks, and the plan of each schema and operation input with every refusal, which a target renders in its own library.

### `@seampact/compiler`

- `packages/core/compiler/src`: Reads the YAML contract, reports errors with file, line and column, and produces the IR.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/bundle`: Contract bundles in the compiler (ADR 0011): the workspace bundled and written as a directory or a reproducible tarball, the tarball reader, the pinned-bundle check, the three channels that fetch a bundle with its cache, workspace imports and the local-source refusal.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/derivations`: The derivation table and the derivation roles of ADR 0006 sections 5 and 6, held as data.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/diagnostics`: Located diagnostics: the diagnostic type, its sort order and the printer.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/finalize`: The finalize stage (ADR 0006 section 1): pruning, canonical ids and ordering, the id collision check, IR validation and serialisation.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/load`: The load stage (ADR 0006 section 1): contract workspaces read into located raw trees.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/access/identity`: The access.identity half (ADR 0006): schemes, headers, identities, per-operation access, bindings and CSRF.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/access/rights`: The access.rights half (ADR 0006): rights, rules, scopes, buckets, per-operation requirements, rule proofs and bucket key checks.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/derive/errors`: The derive.errors half (ADR 0006): errors, natures and per-operation errors.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/derive/wire`: The derive.wire half (ADR 0006): the derived wire members.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/link`: The link pass (ADR 0006): workspace checks across the apis' IRs, such as the relays superset check.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/tree/nodes`: The tree.nodes half (ADR 0006): the api tree, conventions, packs and every tree member but the schemas.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/tree/schemas`: The tree.schemas half (ADR 0006): schemas, scalars, enums and extension keys.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/pipeline`: The pipeline barrel: the seam (`seam.ts`) and the orchestrator with its default parts.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/templates`: The template reader of ADR 0002 section 13, shared by every half that reads a template: the caller gives the slots of the place and a reporter for its own rule ids.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/validate`: The validate stage (ADR 0006 section 1): the raw tree checked against the authoring JSON Schemas.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/workspace`: Workspace order (ADR 0006 section 1): the relay order the apis of a workspace compile in.

### `@seampact/diff`

- `packages/core/diff/src`: The compatibility diff of two contract IRs: the classification table, the release gate and the deprecation report.
- `packages/core/diff/src/deprecation`: The deprecation report of the operations, schemas and properties.
- `packages/core/diff/src/gate`: The release gate: the applied compat policy, the exemptions and the stable maturity refusal.
- `packages/core/diff/src/report`: The text form of a diff report.
- `packages/core/diff/src/table`: The classification table: one row per change kind with its cell per position, and the row of every IR member.
- `packages/core/diff/src/walk`: The structural walk of two IRs: reaches, the catalogue, declaration, operation, access and behaviour comparisons, the change sink and the whole-diff refusals.

### `@seampact/lint`

- `packages/core/lint/src`: The lint plugin API, the core rules (plugin `seampact`) and the runner that applies `lint.rules` and `lint.allow`.
- `packages/core/lint/src/core`: The core lint rules of the plugin `seampact`, one file per rule, and the plugin that lists them.

### `@seampact/openapi`

- `packages/core/openapi/src`: The OpenAPI 3.1 emitter: an api's documents written from the IR through the table of ADR 0004 section 12, the merged document of several apis, the emitter options of A40, the drift check of a committed document, and the `x-seampact-*` extension names whose JSON Schemas the package publishes.
- `packages/core/openapi/src/merge`: The merged document of a monorepo root: several apis' documents written as one, with each api's `prefix`, the identical elements kept once and every clash refused with its fix.

### `@seampact/spec`

- `packages/core/spec/src`: The JSON Schemas of the YAML files and of the IR, with their TypeScript types, the naming vectors and the bundle vectors.
- `packages/core/spec/src/authoring`: The authoring grammar: the JSON Schemas of the YAML files (ADR 0002), their schema keywords and markers.
- `packages/core/spec/src/authoring/grammar`: The grammar modules the authoring JSON Schemas are generated from, one per file and fragment kind (ADR 0002 and 0003).
- `packages/core/spec/src/bundle`: Contract bundles (`@seampact/spec/bundle`, ADR 0011): the manifest types and JSON Schema, the portable-path rule, the canonical file list the integrity hashes, the manifest rules beyond the schema and the failure codes.
- `packages/core/spec/src/compatibility`: The compatibility matrix (`@seampact/spec/compatibility`): the first-party providers of each link kind, per server target the framework majors it is tested on or refuses and the validator styles it accepts, and per client target the framework and query library majors it is tested on and the client link styles it reads.
- `packages/core/spec/src/config`: The app config and the monorepo root config, `seampact.config.yaml` (`@seampact/spec/config`): their types and their JSON Schemas.
- `packages/core/spec/src/ir`: The IR (ADR 0004 and 0005): its JSON Schemas, generated types, writer view, validation and invariants.
- `packages/core/spec/src/json`: JSON helpers every package shares (`@seampact/spec/json`): the canonical text of a value and the JSON Pointer segment escape.
- `packages/core/spec/src/naming`: ADR 0007: cross-language naming.

### `@seampact/hooks`

- `packages/runtime/hooks/src`: The neutral hook interfaces and the idempotency store interface every generated server boundary types against, types only.

### `@seampact/idempotency-memory`

- `packages/runtime/idempotency-memory/src`: An in-memory idempotency store for one process, lost on restart: for development and tests.

### `@seampact/server-runtime`

- `packages/runtime/server-runtime/src`: The shared runtime of the generated Node and Web-standard server boundaries (ADR 0025): the 33 framework-neutral modules at this root export, the transport modules at `/node` and `/web`, and one placement per framework at `/express`, `/fastify`, `/nestjs`, `/adonis` and `/hono`.

### `@seampact/signed-webhooks`

- `packages/runtime/signed-webhooks/src`: The template signature verifier an authenticate hook calls for a signed identity (ADR 0013): HMAC over the raw body, timestamp tolerance and secret rotation; the application keeps its secrets.

### `@seampact/codegen-adonis`

- `packages/targets/codegen-adonis/src`: The AdonisJS server target: the boundary around the app's controllers for each api, placing the shared Node request checks of codegen-core in inline route middleware and a generated route handler, validating with zod.
- `packages/targets/codegen-adonis/src/vinejs`: The VineJS validators the AdonisJS target writes itself when its entry gives no `validators` link: the shape rendered from the shared validator plan, and the Standard Schema adapter that builds the VineJS schema from it and names issues by contract rule.

### `@seampact/codegen-angular`

- `packages/targets/codegen-angular/src`: The angular target: an injectable api service per api whose fetch client sends through the app's `HttpClient`, with signal readers built on Angular's `resource()` and mutations with no cache, from the shared query plan, with the front runtime copied beside them.
- `packages/targets/codegen-angular/src/fetch`: The plain fetch renderer of the angular target (`query: fetch`): `service.ts`, the `<Api>Api` service with signal readers on Angular's `resource()` and mutations over the shared fetcher factory of codegen-core, and `http-client-fetch.ts`, the fetch that sends through the app's `HttpClient`.
- `packages/targets/codegen-angular/src/ngrx`: NgRx action groups and effects over the generated api service, for the option `state: ngrx`, and the call flows they share with `state: ngrx-signals`.
- `packages/targets/codegen-angular/src/ngrx-signals`: Signal Store features over the generated api service, one per operation, for the option `state: ngrx-signals`.

### `@seampact/codegen-axios`

- `packages/targets/codegen-axios/src`: The axios client target: the fetch client over your own axios instance, generated with the fetch target's client and runtime and an adapter module, providing the same `client` link the front targets consume.

### `@seampact/codegen-class-validator`

- `packages/targets/codegen-class-validator/src`: The class-validator validators target: decorated DTO classes per schema and direction, custom constraints for the contract rules class-validator lacks, and Standard Schema adapters validating with strict options, provided as the `validators` link of style `class-validator`, which the NestJS target reads.

### `@seampact/codegen-express`

- `packages/targets/codegen-express/src`: The Express server target: a router per api that places the shared Node request checks of `@seampact/server-runtime` around the app's handler map, on Express 4 and 5, validating with zod.

### `@seampact/codegen-fastify`

- `packages/targets/codegen-fastify/src`: The Fastify server target: an encapsulated plugin per api that places the shared Node request checks of codegen-core around the app's handler map, on Fastify 5, validating with a validators link or with Ajv.
- `packages/targets/codegen-fastify/src/ajv`: The Ajv validators the Fastify target writes itself when its entry gives no `validators` link: the JSON Schema rendered from the shared validator plan, and the Standard Schema adapter that names issues by contract rule.

### `@seampact/codegen-fetch`

- `packages/targets/codegen-fetch/src`: The fetch client target: one typed method per operation over the platform fetch, reading its request, success and error types from the `types` link and providing the `client` link the front targets consume.

### `@seampact/codegen-hono`

- `packages/targets/codegen-hono/src`: The Hono server target: a `registerRoutes` function per api that places the shared request checks of `@seampact/server-runtime`, in their Web-standard profile, around the app's handler map on Hono 4, validating with zod.

### `@seampact/codegen-msw`

- `packages/targets/codegen-msw/src`: The MSW target: Mock Service Worker 2 handlers per operation, answering the contract's example or the typed success or error a test gives, written in the api's wire format so the generated fetch client reads them.

### `@seampact/codegen-nestjs`

- `packages/targets/codegen-nestjs/src`: The NestJS server target: the boundary around the app's controllers for each api, placing the shared Node request checks of codegen-core in NestJS's middleware, guard, input pipe, a handler wrapper or reply interceptor and filter, validating with zod.

### `@seampact/codegen-react`

- `packages/targets/codegen-react/src`: The React target: TanStack Query or SWR options and hooks, or an RTK Query api, per api over the linked fetch client, from the shared query plan, with the front runtime copied beside them.
- `packages/targets/codegen-react/src/fetch`: The plain fetch renderer of the react target (`query: fetch`): the server-safe `queries.ts` (one fetcher per operation) and the `"use client"` `hooks.ts` built on React state and effects, with no query library.
- `packages/targets/codegen-react/src/rtk`: The RTK Query renderer of the react target: the `api.ts` of each api over `createApi` and `fakeBaseQuery`, with plain store errors, from the shared query plan.
- `packages/targets/codegen-react/src/shared`: The source part the react target's query libraries share that is React's own: the `"use client"` directive (the other shared parts come from codegen-core).
- `packages/targets/codegen-react/src/swr`: The SWR renderer of the react target: the server-safe `queries.ts` (keys and `{ key, fetcher }` pairs) and the `"use client"` `hooks.ts` of each api, from the shared query plan.
- `packages/targets/codegen-react/src/tanstack`: The TanStack Query renderer of the react target: the server-safe `queries.ts` and the `"use client"` `hooks.ts` of each api, from the shared query plan.

### `@seampact/codegen-ts`

- `packages/targets/codegen-ts/src`: The TypeScript types target: one named type per schema and enum, and each operation's input, output and error union, provided to the other targets as the `types` link.

### `@seampact/codegen-vue`

- `packages/targets/codegen-vue/src`: The Vue target: TanStack Query options and composables, or plain fetch composables on Vue's `ref` and `watch`, per api over the linked fetch client, from the shared query plan, with the front runtime copied beside them.
- `packages/targets/codegen-vue/src/fetch`: The plain fetch renderer of the vue target (`query: fetch`): `composables.ts`, built on Vue's `ref` and `watch` alone over the shared fetcher factory of codegen-core, with no query library and no cache.
- `packages/targets/codegen-vue/src/pinia-colada`: The Pinia Colada renderer of the vue target (`query: pinia-colada`): the `queries.ts` options factories over `@pinia/colada` `define*Options`, and `composables.ts`, one `use*` composable per factory taking a reactive request.
- `packages/targets/codegen-vue/src/tanstack`: The TanStack Query renderer of the vue target (`query: tanstack`): the `queries.ts` options factories shared with codegen-core over `@tanstack/vue-query`, and `composables.ts`, one `use*` composable per factory taking a reactive request.

### `@seampact/codegen-yup`

- `packages/targets/codegen-yup/src`: The yup validators target: Standard Schema validators per schema and direction, with object schemas left unrefined so an app can extend them, and one input validator per operation, provided as the `validators` link.

### `@seampact/codegen-zod`

- `packages/targets/codegen-zod/src`: The zod validators target: Standard Schema validators per schema and direction, with object schemas left unrefined so an app can extend them, and one input validator per operation, provided as the `validators` link.

### `@seampact/binary`

- `packages/tools/binary/src`: The standalone compiler binary: the CLI entry the single executable wraps, the commands it runs on native target entries only, and the reader serving the embedded first-party packs.

### `@seampact/docs-site`

- `packages/tools/docs-site/src/prebuild`: The prebuild of the docs site: copies docs/ into Starlight's content folder, adds the site-only home page, takes each page's title from its first heading, rewrites relative links to site routes or GitHub links, and writes the sidebar from the docs index.

### `@seampact/http-suite`

- `packages/tools/http-suite/src`: The shared black-box HTTP suite (ADR 0015): the JSON case format and its shipped cases, the sample app's control routes and the script a sample app answers from, a runner against a base URL, the format readers of the pack profiles, the boot variants and their runner, and the report keyed by checklist id.

### `seampact-codegen`

- `python/codegen/src/seampact/codegen`: The neutral code generation of the Python targets: the plan every target shares (names, layout, refusals by name, the route table and the route helpers), the line printer, and the Pydantic emitter FastAPI and Ninja share.
- `python/codegen/src/seampact/codegen/runtime`: The framework-free runtime of generated Python code: step 1's raw-target match and decoding, the wire codec, replies, the outgoing verdict, the pattern check, the runtime version (G3) and the sync driver of the steps, which are written once as coroutines.
- `python/codegen/src/seampact/codegen/runtime/pydantic`: The type layer of the generated Pydantic models FastAPI and Ninja share: annotated types whose `BeforeValidator` turns a decoded wire value into the Python object Pydantic's strict mode expects (a whole-number float into an `int`; `date-time`, `date`, `uuid` and decimal strings, and enum values, into their objects), and the validators of `rules: seampact-consistent`, each failing with the contract rule's name as its Pydantic error type.

### `seampact-compiler`

- `python/compiler/src/seampact/compiler`: The seampact compiler binary of this platform, the release asset unchanged, under `bin/`.

### `seampact-django`

- `python/django/src/seampact/django`: The Django layer the DRF and Ninja targets share: the emitters of each api's URLconf, settings and boundary modules, the `seampact.django` app an app lists in `INSTALLED_APPS`, and the Django runtime of generated code.
- `python/django/src/seampact/django/emitters`: The emitters of the modules every Django target writes per api: the URLconf of the contract paths, the typed settings the api reads from `settings.SEAMPACT`, the boundary middleware's declaration, and the options every Django target reads.
- `python/django/src/seampact/django/management`: The management commands of the seampact Django layer.
- `python/django/src/seampact/django/management/commands`: `seampact_check` and `seampact_generate`.
- `python/django/src/seampact/django/runtime`: The Django runtime of generated code: the boundary middleware every api's generated boundary derives from, its per-request state, the replies it writes, the boot check, and the handler factories an api reads from `settings.SEAMPACT`.

### `seampact-drf`

- `python/drf/src/seampact/drf`: The Django REST Framework target: the `seampact-drf` generator, found through the `seampact.generators` entry point, its emitters (frozen dataclass types, operation types and handler protocols, serializers and `APIView` declarations), and the DRF runtime of the code it generates.
- `python/drf/src/seampact/drf/runtime`: The DRF runtime of generated code: the base of the contract views and serializers, the typed field that keeps a value the type layer converted, the value-rule validators, the contract exception handler and the boundary the generated one extends.

### `seampact-fastapi`

- `python/fastapi/src/seampact/fastapi`: The FastAPI target of seampact (ADR 0026): the generator `seampact generate` finds through the `seampact.generators` entry point, behind the `generate` extra, and the placement runtime the generated code imports.
- `python/fastapi/src/seampact/fastapi/runtime`: The FastAPI placement runtime the generated code imports (ADR 0026 "What the generated code depends on"): the declarations of one api's placement, its binding, its contract routes with the access and input dependencies, the boundary middleware, the exception map and the boot check.

### `seampact-hooks`

- `python/hooks/src/seampact/hooks`: The hook protocols an app implements and the values they exchange, with the shape every hooks package shares.

### `seampact-ir`

- `python/ir/src/seampact/ir`: The seampact IR for Python generators (ADR 0010): the generated model, the native naming and the reader.
- `python/ir/src/seampact/ir/binary`: The compiler binary of a Python build (ADR 0010): wheel lookup, pin, platform, private cache and runner.
- `python/ir/src/seampact/ir/bundle`: The bundle reader and verifier (ADR 0011): reads a tarball or a directory, runs the pinned-bundle check.
- `python/ir/src/seampact/ir/config`: The app config of a Python build (ADR 0011 "The app config"): the YAML read, the schema check, the entry view.
- `python/ir/src/seampact/ir/https`: The HTTPS download both release channels share (the bundle tarball and the compiler binary), with the printable URL and the quoting of untrusted text their messages use.
- `python/ir/src/seampact/ir/naming`: The native naming of ADR 0007: name segments, roles, operation ids and Python identifiers, checked against the shared vectors.
- `python/ir/src/seampact/ir/read`: The IR reader: the nesting, support and must-act checks of ADR 0005, then the generated model's hydrator.
- `python/ir/src/seampact/ir/run`: The `seampact` runner of a Python build: `generate` and `check` an app config with the targets installed as `seampact.generators` entry points, and the documents through the compiler binary.
- `python/ir/src/seampact/ir/write`: The generated-file writer (ADR 0015 "Writing files" and "The generated header"): plans and commits the files of one target entry in its output directory.

### `seampact-ninja`

- `python/ninja/src/seampact/ninja`: The Django Ninja target of seampact: the `seampact-ninja` generator and the runtime of the code it generates.
- `python/ninja/src/seampact/ninja/runtime`: The Ninja placement runtime the generated code imports (ADR 0027 "Ninja"): the declarations of one api's placement, its binding and Router, its boundary middleware, the body of its views and their handler calls.

### `seampact-signed-webhooks`

- `python/signed-webhooks/src/seampact/signed_webhooks`: The template signature verifier an authenticate hook calls for a signed identity (ADR 0013).

### `scripts`

- `scripts/bench`: Local benchmark harness: each seampact server of the compatibility matrix against the same routes hand-written on the bare framework, and a profile of where the boundary spends its time.
- `scripts/cartography`: Generates docs/agents/cartography.md from package manifests and directory headers.
- `scripts/checklist`: Checks the conformance checklist against the CI jobs and suite reports, and renders the report.
- `scripts/ci`: CI helpers: the matrix row reader, the merge group pull request reader of `ci-watch`, and the tests of the shared GitHub Actions (change filter, change range, row classes, lane aggregate) and of the workflows' row classes, two tiers, merge queue triggers and `ci-watch` list.
- `scripts/consumers`: Test consumers of the packed packages: build, pack, assemble a consumer from the template and a target overlay after its chain of base overlays (each `overlay.base` lists its bases one per line, each base's own chain first, of any depth, never a cycle), then install, generate, check (clean, then after a hand edit of a generated file, which must name that file), typecheck and test it (scripts/consumers). Consumer sources use `.mts` so the monorepo's own typecheck and test globs leave them to the consumer, where they are checked. `--validators <id>` (default `zod`) picks the validator library a consumer generates with, from `validator-choice.ts`. `--pack <name>` builds a server consumer from the reference contract with `@seampact/pack-<name>` applied (its golden case, `fixtures/golden/pack-<name>/`), copies the `pack/` overlay last and runs that pack's suite profile in place of the target's own profiles, reporting to `reports/http-suite-pack-<name>.json`. The test step runs the `default`, `hand-written` and `boot` profiles of `@seampact/http-suite` and writes one report per profile, keyed by checklist id and naming the target (`.seampact-target`), to `reports/http-suite-<profile>.json` in the consumer. The HTTP profiles run against the server the overlay starts; each boot case starts `test/boot-entry.mts` under `tsx` in a process of its own with a misconfigured variant (`src/boot-variant.mts`), which the template's hooks and each overlay's handler registration apply. Each overlay serves the suite's control routes beside the contract routes, from the template's `src/suite-control.mts`; the template's hooks and handlers answer from the script a case loads and record each authenticate and decide call. The `front` overlay adds a Vitest browser project on Playwright Chromium, whose headless shell the run installs; when the base overlay provides `test/server.mts`, its config starts that server, proxies the apis' base paths and the control routes to it from the page's origin, and provides its URL and credentials to `test/front/*.browser.test.*`; `front-fetch` (on `hono` and `front`) drives the generated fetch client there. The `vite` overlay (on `front`) adds Vite and builds the consumer's app for production. The `react` overlay (on `vite`) adds React and the stricter tsconfig of a default Vite React TypeScript app; `react-tanstack` (on `hono` and `react`) generates TanStack Query options and hooks over the fetch client and drives them in the browser against the Hono server. `react-swr` and `react-rtk` (each on `hono` and `react`) do the same with SWR hooks and the RTK Query api; the compatibility matrix tests React 19 on `react-tanstack`, and `@tanstack/react-query` 5, `swr` 2 and `@reduxjs/toolkit` 2 with `react-redux` 9 on their own overlays. The `vue` overlay (on `vite`) adds Vue 3 and `vitest-browser-vue`; `vue-tanstack`, `vue-pinia-colada` and `vue-fetch` (each on `hono` and `vue`) generate Vue Query, Pinia Colada and plain fetch composables over the fetch client and drive them in the browser against the Hono server. The `angular` overlay (on `vite`) adds Angular 22, compiled in the page by its JIT compiler with no build step; `angular-fetch` (on `hono` and `angular`) generates the Angular api service over the fetch client, sending through `HttpClient`, and drives its readers and mutations in the browser against the Hono server. `angular-ngrx` (on `hono` and `angular`) generates the NgRx action groups and effects over that service and dispatches them through the app's own store and reducer. `front-msw` (on `front` alone) generates MSW handlers and runs the fetch client against them with no server, in its own node project under `setupServer` and in the browser project under `setupWorker`, with its own Vitest config and tsconfig that leave out the template's server tests. `angular-ngrx-signals` (on `hono` and `angular`) generates the Signal Store features over that service and composes them into the app's own `signalStore`. The Spring Boot, Laravel, Symfony, API Platform and FastAPI consumers are built by their own scripts (`targets/spring-boot/README.md`, `targets/laravel/README.md`, `targets/symfony/README.md`, `targets/api-platform/README.md`, `targets/fastapi/README.md`); `served-app.ts` starts their server process on a free port for their suite. The Python consumers share `python/` (`python/README.md`): the hash-pinned install from built wheels, the uvicorn and gunicorn launchers, the boot runner and the suite doubles behind the control routes.
- `scripts/coverage-floors`: Coverage floors: `floors.json`, the lowest line and branch coverage each package may fall to, and `check.ts`, which checks a vitest, coverage.py or Cobertura summary against them in CI (the JVM build checks JaCoCo itself with `-PseampactCoverage`).
- `scripts/determinism`: The generation determinism matrix (CHK-103): each Node target generated from the reference contract twice and from its inline and included forms, with the output trees compared byte for byte.
- `scripts/dist-smoke`: Channel smoke harness (ADR 0011 "Channel smoke tests"): a loopback npm registry, a loopback HTTPS server and a local bare git repository serving a bundle of the reference contract and a tampered copy, the Node CLI run against each, and `cli.ts serve` for the native legs.
- `scripts/golden`: Golden checker, the scale fixture generator and their tests (scripts/golden).
- `scripts/hooks`: The git pre-commit and pre-push hooks installed by pnpm install.
- `scripts/ir-models`: Writes or checks the native IR models of the targets.
- `scripts/package-rules`: Checks the package roles, dependency rules and namespaces of the npm, Gradle and Composer manifests.
- `scripts/release`: Release scripts of `release.yml`: the version stamp and its check, the npm packing with its content check, the idempotent publish to npm, the local registry of the rehearsal, and the check of the binaries against `SHA256SUMS`; `jvm/` holds the Maven Central and Gradle Plugin Portal side, and `registry-proof/` the consumers that install a release from the registries.
- `scripts/skills`: Writes or checks the skills folder, whose references are generated from docs/.
- `scripts/validator-agreement`: The validator agreement runner: generates the validators of each first-party provider from the agreement contract and checks that they give the same verdict and contract rule per table row (scripts/validator-agreement).
- `scripts/workspace`: Workspace layout helpers shared by the repository scripts: where the npm packages live.

### `jvm`

- `jvm/build-logic`: The Gradle convention plugins every published seampact JVM module applies: Java 21 bytecode, the `testJdk` switch and the Maven publication with its POM metadata.
- `jvm/gradle`: The Gradle wrapper, the version catalog and the dependency verification metadata shared by the JVM modules.
- `jvm/seampact-compiler`: The pinned compiler publication the JVM build plugins run to generate Spring Boot code.
- `jvm/seampact-gradle-plugin`: The Gradle plugin that generates the Spring Boot code of a seampact contract from a pinned bundle or the pinned compiler.
- `jvm/seampact-hooks`: The access hook interfaces and runtime types the generated Java code of seampact imports.
- `jvm/seampact-ir`: The seampact IR model and reader, the contract bundle channels, the pinned compiler binary and the app config reader.
- `jvm/seampact-maven-plugin`: The Maven plugin that generates the Spring Boot code of a seampact contract from a pinned bundle or the pinned compiler.
- `jvm/seampact-runner`: The seampact run both JVM build plugins share: app config, IR, generation and checks.
- `jvm/seampact-signed-webhooks`: Verifies template-signed webhooks (HMAC-SHA256) behind the seampact authenticate hook.
- `jvm/seampact-spring-boot`: The seampact Spring Boot server generator both build plugins call.
- `jvm/seampact-spring-runtime`: The boundary runtime the Spring Boot code generated by seampact imports.

### `php`

- `php/api-platform`: The API Platform 5 target: resources, operations and processors of a contract on top of the Symfony target.
- `php/codegen`: The framework-neutral PHP emitters the PHP targets share: value types, enums, naming, refusals and the golden tree.
- `php/hooks`: The hook interfaces, decision and subject types for PHP that generated boundaries call and applications implement.
- `php/ir`: The seampact IR model and reader for PHP.
- `php/laravel`: The Laravel 13 target: FormRequests, types, controller interfaces, routes and boundary of a contract.
- `php/signed-webhooks`: Verifies template-signed webhooks for PHP: HMAC over the raw body, timestamp tolerance and secret rotation.
- `php/symfony`: The Symfony 7.4 and 8 target: types, controller interfaces, routes, constraints and bundle of a contract.

### `.github/actions`

- `.github/actions/compiler-binary`: Puts the linux-x64 compiler binary at its dist path, from cache or a fresh build.
- `.github/actions/composer-cache`: Caches Composer's downloaded archives per workflow and job, and retries Composer on network failure.
- `.github/actions/gradle-retry`: Appends the dependency retry keys of jvm/gradle.properties to the Gradle user properties once per job.
- `.github/actions/lane-aggregate`: Fails a lane's required check when a job it needs failed, was cancelled or was skipped without cause.
- `.github/actions/lane-changes`: Says whether a lane runs, from the changed paths against the lane's watched paths.
- `.github/actions/maven-cache`: Restores or saves the Maven distribution and third-party artifacts of the Spring Boot Maven consumer.
